lead.tldr: US Marshals insider theft exposes federal crypto custody vulnerabilities, raising risks for government-held reserves. • PBOC bans yuan-pegged stablecoins, further isolating China from global crypto asset tokenization. • Bitcoin rebounds 11% toward $58K support as institutional dip-buyers stabilize post-crash volatility. • Gloria Zhao exits Bitcoin Core amid OP_RETURN disputes, signaling potential developer friction.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, Security threats intensify with U.S. Marshals crypto theft and privacy coins in hack laundering. Bitcoin rebounds 11% toward $58K amid maintainer drama.

top_signals.title: U.S. Marshals Service under scrutiny after insider allegedly stole $25 million from federal crypto wallets
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Marshals Service is investigating an alleged insider theft of approximately $25 million in cryptocurrency from government-controlled wallets, with the suspect identified as John Daghita, son of the CEO of Command Services & Support (CMDSS), a contractor hired to manage seized digital assets. The stolen funds originated from wallets holding cryptocurrency seized in connection with the 2016 Bitfinex hack, and were traced through multiple exchanges and bridges in a structured laundering operation before roughly $700,000 remained unaccounted for. CMDSS won a $40 million contract in October 2024 to manage confiscated cryptocurrencies despite lacking SEC and FINRA licenses, exposing vulnerabilities in how the federal government secures billions of dollars in seized crypto assets. This incident underscores systemic risks in government crypto custody, as the Marshals Service has historically relied on basic spreadsheet tracking and lacks comprehensive internal controls for managing its digital asset holdings.

top_signals.title: PBOC Officially Bans 'Unapproved' Yuan-Pegged Stablecoins
top_signals.summary: The People's Bank of China (PBOC) has officially banned the issuance of yuan-pegged stablecoins and the tokenization of assets without prior approval. This regulatory action signals a tightening of control over cryptocurrency-related activities within China.

top_signals.title: Controversial Bitcoin developer Gloria Zhao steps down as Core maintainer
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin Core maintainer Gloria Zhao has resigned from her position. The resignation occurs amidst ongoing debate surrounding OP_RETURN, with some suggesting harassment contributed to her decision.

top_signals.title: Why Privacy Coins Often Appear in Post-Hack Fund Flows
top_signals.summary: The article discusses how stolen crypto funds from hacks often pass through privacy coins as a laundering step. It explains why privacy coins are used in this process, but not as the final cash-out asset.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin Traders Say $58K is Key as Dip-Buyers Help BTC Rebound 11%
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin rebounded 11% as dip-buyers, including crypto hedge funds and Binance, entered the market after a significant crash. Traders are eyeing $58K as a key level.
